turns: can i exchange my bedsheet for a different colour?
notes: No exchanges: return the item within its window and order the one wanted.

turns: is there any extra fee for cash on delivery
notes: No extra charge for cash on delivery; the usual shipping charge applies.

turns: how do i change the phone number on my account
notes: In account settings, confirmed with a one-time code.

turns: my ticket says in progress, what does that mean
notes: In progress: the support team is working on it.

turns: part of my order came already. usually how long until the second box ships?
notes: A later shipment usually ships 1-2 days after the first. General question; looking up the customer's own split order is fine too.

turns: what should i do if something arrives damaged?
notes: Start a return with the reason 'damaged in transit' within the item's return window.

turns: if i return just one thing from an order, is the refund only for that item?
notes: Yes: the refund is the price paid for the returned items only.

turns: how long does the courier investigation take for a lost parcel
notes: The carrier investigation gives a result within 5 business days.

turns: does a wallet refund take as long as a card refund?
notes: Wallet 1-3 business days, card 5-7 business days after the refund is sent.

turns: my refund was sent on a friday. from when do you count the business days?
notes: A refund sent on a Friday is counted from the following Monday.

turns: i moved and changed the address in my account. will my order that's already on the way come to the new place?

must_not_include: will be delivered to your new address
will come to your new address
will arrive at your new address

notes: Changing the saved address does not move placed orders; a shipped order's address cannot be changed.

turns: someone called saying they are from nimbuscart and asked for my otp. do you ask for that?
notes: Nova never asks for a password, OTP, full card number, CVV or UPI PIN.
